Routines

top source crisp2::selectfiles

CRISP2 pipeline

crisp2::selectfiles [, cam=string] [, complement=intarr] [, count=integer] [, /dark] [, dirs=strarr] [, files=strarr] [, /flat] [, /force], fpi_states=fpi_states, framenumbers=framenumbers [, ncomplement=integer] [, nremove=int] [, /polcal] [, prefilter=strarr] [, scan=intarr] [, selected=intarr] [, states=strarr], strip_settings=strip_settings, subdir=subdir, timestamps=timestamps [, ustat=strarr]

Select (a subset) of files and return their filenames and state information

Keywords

cam in optional type=string

Name of the camera channel. Ex. 'Crisp-W'

complement out optional type=intarr

The complement of selected.

count out optional type=integer

The number of selected files.

dark in optional type=boolean

If no dirs were specified, use self.dark_dir

dirs in optional type=strarr

Locations where to find files.

files in optional type=strarr

File-list. No file search will be done

flat in optional type=boolean

If no dirs were specified, use self.flat_dir

force in optional type=boolean

Re-populate files/states.

fpi_states
framenumbers
ncomplement out optional type=integer

The number of non-selected files.

nremove in optional type=int

Skip this many frames after each state-change

polcal in optional type=boolean

Set this to add polcal-specific items in the states, qw and lp.

prefilter in optional type=strarr

only return files matching at least one of these prefilters

scan in optional type=intarr

Only return files matching these scan numbers.

selected out optional type=intarr

Return the indices for the selection. If this is not specified, the files/states arrays will be over-written to only contain the selection.

states in optional type=strarr

State information. Extractstates will only be called if files were updated.

strip_settings
subdir
timestamps
ustat in optional type=strarr

only return files matching at least one of these states

Author information

Author:

Tomas Hillberg, ISP

History:

2016-05-19 : First version.

2016-06-01 : THI. Allow filtering on camera tag. Pass keyword strip_settings to extractstates.

2016-06-02 : MGL. Remove some keywords to extractstates.

2016-06-09 : MGL. Bugfix: states.pref --> states.prefilter.

2016-08-23 : THI. Rename camtag to detector and channel to camera, so the names match those of the corresponding SolarNet keywords.

2016-08-31 : MGL. Update file_template for data files not starting with the detector name.

2016-09-23 : THI. Add selection by scannumber

2016-10-13 : THI. Add selection by framenumbers and option strip_wb to be forwarded to extractstates

2016-10-27 : MGL. New keywords count, complement, and ncomplement.

2017-12-20 : MGL. Always do extractstates, if the files are the same this is a fast operation now because of caching.

2017-12-21 : MGL. Do extractstates only if needed.

2018-05-30 : MGL. Add selection by fpi_states.

2022-08-02 : MGL. CRISP2 version, based mostly on the one for CHROMIS.

2024-06-19 : Pit. Make camera search a substring match, as it can be something like 'Crisp-D, Crisp-W' for PD data
